[!exec:node] skip 'node is required to run js/wasm binaries'

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOOS=js
env GOARCH=wasm

logos build -p=1 -o control.wasm .
exec $GOROOT/lib/wasm/go_js_wasm_exec control.wasm
stderr '^ok$'

logos build -p=1 -gcflags=-logos.wasmassume=main.yield -o wrong.wasm .
! exec $GOROOT/lib/wasm/go_js_wasm_exec wrong.wasm
stderr 'RuntimeError: unreachable'
! stderr '^ok$'

env GOOS=
env GOARCH=

-- go.mod --
module example.com/wasmwrongmayyield

go 1.27

-- main.go --
// Copyright 2026 The Go Authors. All rights reserved.
// Use of this source code is governed by a BSD-style
// license that can be found in the LICENSE file.

package main

import "runtime"

//go:noinline
func yield() { runtime.Gosched() }

func main() {
	yield()
	println("ok")
}
